name: Necropolis of Dreams
descriptionTemplate: Gain [Block:Arg1] Shield and [Counterattack:Arg2] stacks of {Counter}. The next {Leap} this turn is guaranteed to trigger. Choose to consume {Dreamlure} stacks to trigger {Slumber Counter} or {Echoes of Whispers}. If the number of {Dreamlure} stacks is less than 5, obtain 1 stack of {Dreamlure}.
lore:
Her capital is an ever-expanding ruin.
Dreams die here completely, but the ruin remains oblivious. It simply expands as it is meant to.
The world has long forgotten it.
